name: Ruber M. vulpez
source: A young detective with natural talent and cunning, his skills are broken down from detailed deduction and analysis. His personality is gentle and he likes to treat things with an analytical eye. In addition to his conscience, he possesses a second voice that occasionally cooperates with cases or just annoys him.
